reviews.text: Diana is very good, she has a lot of patience and she knows how to deal with my dog ​​who is a bit wild let's say😊
I recommend them to everyone, they are truly professional. Today I took my dog ​​to have her teeth cleaned with an innovative system... Stefano really did a great job, thank you very much.

I took my dog ​​for a teeth cleaning today without anesthesia!!! Wow, I didn't expect such results. In half an hour, my dog ​​was reborn. I recommend it to everyone. The price is right for the service.

I'm bringing my Jack Russell here and I'm very happy with the grooming. Today I had my teeth cleaned for the first time without anesthesia, and the results were fantastic! My furry friend and I are very satisfied! Thank you!

I brought my friend Pop
For a hyper-ozonized water shower experience
Top

Dogmotics on Via Tuscolana is a well-stocked and well-maintained shop, ideal for those seeking quality products for their pet. It also offers professional grooming and a convenient 24-hour self-service service. Friendly and helpful staff. Highly recommended!

I'm truly satisfied with the grooming service. I brought both my dog ​​and cat and was impressed by the care and professionalism.

The staff was kind and very attentive, especially in making the animals feel comfortable. You can tell they have experience and passion for what they do. The end result was perfect: soft, clean, and well-groomed fur.
Super professional, my dog ​​came out of there looking like a diva. Super sweet and cuddly with animals.
Perfect dressing table and exquisite staff, see you soon

5 stars!
This is my third time coming to this shop, and Barbara, the groomer, always takes care of the haircut for my little, chubby Maltese, who's just over a year old. After every grooming session, my dog ​​looks like a real princess! My family and I are always very satisfied and happy.

I'd also like to say that Barbara is a truly professional, kind, and beautiful groomer. She always manages to make my dog ​​look gorgeous with a perfect cut. I highly recommend the shop owner give her a raise, hehe!

I will definitely keep coming back to this shop!
A+!! The girls are excellent, Barbara is very sweet with the furry friends, a guarantee for our Sophie and for us. Thank you!

I've been a DogMotics customer for years. Giordano's kindness, Barbara and Diana's professionalism, and the gentle way they treat my dog ​​Pippo while caring for him are unparalleled. My dog ​​is very emotional, but he's calm with them and lets them wash and dry him without fear.
Kindness, courtesy, and professionalism, I highly recommend
I brought my poodle for the first time, I have to say that I was very happy, perfect cut, very kind and qualified staff, I recommend it
A well-deserved five stars! The staff is expert, friendly, and super punctual. My puppy came out beautiful and not stressed at all. The best grooming service in the area, highly recommended.

I took my dog ​​to this groomer and, unfortunately, the experience was very negative. He came home agitated and scared, and since then he has become wary of people, something he hadn't done before. This makes me think he wasn't treated with the proper care. Considering the price, I can only express my great disappointment and recommend this service against it.

If I could, I'd give it ZERO STARS!

I brought my dog ​​and he was visibly traumatized. Now he no longer lets others pet him, whereas he never did before. I'm convinced he was mistreated. I strongly advise against this grooming service: €50 spent on a negative and unacceptable experience.
We just used the self-service laundry for the first time. It was very convenient, and the lady who greeted us (I think the owner's mother) was helpful and very kind!

I've always had poodles and always come here to settle down. Oksana always did Matisse and Dalí there, she was truly excellent, while I only entrust my current one, Ares, to Barbara, who specializes in poodles and always makes him beautiful and impeccably done. A guarantee!
A thousand thanks

I'll start by saying that I'm an old customer and I don't live in the area. The last time I brought my Maltese for a wash and cut, I paid by credit card and I didn't realize the price, which is reasonable because I usually pay 35 euros. I ended up with a payment of 50 euros. I called to get an explanation. The same person who had washed the dog answered and claimed that the dog was large, full of knots and that it had given him a lot of problems. I asked for the owner to call me. He called and left the number several times and I didn't receive any calls. I'm sorry, but you've lost 2 customers.

I will never take my dog ​​to this toilet again...the place is really dirty and the staff is unqualified...if you don't like this job, don't do it...they ruined and traumatized my dog...blood everywhere just to cut his nails...very high prices...plus the two ladies are unpleasant and rude

I brought my dog ​​for a simple wash, but when I went to pick him up, not only had they washed him, but they had also shaved his face completely wrong for that breed. You never completely uncover a Lagotto Romagnolo's eyes, and you don't completely shave his nose! They gave him a poodle face. All this without asking me anything, and given the importance of a dog's muzzle shape, it would have been the least they could ask, especially since the shape my dog ​​had and the one the girl found was completely different. Despite my disappointment and dismay, they didn't even offer a discount. I paid €40 to transform my Lagotto into a disconcerting Lagotto/poodle hybrid. I would have been happy just to pick him up clean!
I'm attaching two before-and-after photos. 😱

I've been bringing my dog ​​for a wash and a trim for a few years now. I'm very happy with the staff, especially Barbara. The staff is very professional and respectful, and they pay great attention to detail. I'm more than satisfied with the service and the way my dog ​​is cared for!

Barbara is a top groomer!
My cocker spaniel has been in her care for 8 years.
Highly recommend her.
Excellent service, kind and qualified staff
They've become my go-to beauty salon. They're always available, very kind, and very professional. Highly recommended. They deserve 10 stars.

I brought my Maltese, and they did an excellent job.
Very satisfied, they were really good.

Courtesy, professionalism, and politeness, highly recommended, and excellent prices.
The owner, Giordano, is always extremely helpful.

A positive experience!!! They offer a service I can't find elsewhere (I come from Frascati). You can basically wash your dog yourself. I have three dogs, including a Maremma Sheepdog, a Spinone, and a Pinscher, so I prefer to wash them myself, because not all three are comfortable being washed by anyone other than my husband and me. So, I find it very convenient to be able to use this service. The owner is very kind. Thank you.

For just €19, you can wash your four-legged friend in complete comfort and safety. The tub with a shower head that releases water, shampoo, and conditioner is a nice touch! My boss loved the experience!
Nice structure, they also have boxes for washing dogs independently, comfortable and convenient

We used the self-service option for our poodle this evening. It was exceptional. The lady who guided us was very kind and friendly. We highly recommend the self-service option. We'll definitely be back.

The "groomer," I think from her accent, Russian, and I'm just saying that so you know who she is, was about to BREAK the paws of my two Burmese cats, who are used to being groomed. She's rude, clumsy, and violent with cats. My cats were biting each other when they finished. Never happened before. A place to avoid if you don't want your pets to be abused.
Expensive and not very good! To be avoided.
Since I discovered this grooming shop for my Wendy I have never changed, the staff are kind and professional, and also loving with their four-legged customers.

We took our cat (whom we bathe only after returning from vacation, where he lived wild in the countryside for two months) to this grooming salon, which is quite far from our house because it's open on Sundays. The washing and grooming were very thorough. However, we'd like to point out that we asked for his nails to be trimmed, and they were cut so short that they bled. This is the first time this has happened to us, and we might have "understood" it, had it not been for the fact that we'd been told that the cat reacted badly to the drying process, and by becoming agitated, he cut himself and his paws bled. When we got home, however, we noticed that his nails were practically gone...

Today was the third time I took my dog ​​(Sam, a Pembroke Welsh Corgi) to this groomer, and I'll never go back. The first time, everything was fine because the owner took care of bathing him, etc. The second time, which was a month ago, however, since my dog ​​had fleas, the vet told me to give him a flea bath, so I took him there for €35, with nails trimmed and trimmed in the right places. Today, I took him back after a month because he had fleas again... so I'm asking for a flea bath and that's it. 1) the girl tells me 50 minutes, I come back after 50 minutes but my dog ​​is not ready yet and I find him on the table alone, half-dried and barking (of course), and another Maltese in the tray, all wet and shivering, and the two girls drinking coffee... 2) she kicks me out because as soon as my dog ​​sees me he starts barking more (who knows why 🙄). 3) she finishes drying them in 10/15 minutes and then asks me for €38. So I ask her the reason for this price increase and the lady replies that this is the price for doing the anti-parasitic bath and cutting the nails 🤦🏻‍♀️ and then I ask: but the other time she took €35 and she comes out with "ah but the other time I didn't do the anti-parasitic bath" 🤦🏻‍♀️ I mean....so what the heck do you work for if you don't know how to do your job? 🙄🙄🙄
Professional
Great place to wash your dog independently
We have been using them for years and they are excellent.
VERY GOOD and very kind
I brought my poodle Nino for the first time. He's beautiful and, above all, calm. Thank you, Barbara, you're very good.
All very efficient.
